subject: Rendering an image client-side before sending it to the server

messages.author: 98166cebe3eff2a1
messages.subject: Rendering an image client-side before sending it to the server
parts:
I’m writing a Shiny app that lets the user upload an image to a server, before doing some computing on it. The computing takes some time, so I’d like to be able to show the image on the screen without uploading it first and then waiting for the server to get back to me. I was using the standard renderImage/imageOutput methods from Shiny before, but this requires the file to be uploaded and the work to finish before the image is actually shown.

With some assistance from StackOverflow, I've managed to get to the following. It works fine for the first uploaded image. The problem I'm getting now is that when I use the upload control again, the new image gets displayed next to/below the older ones. That is, the images from older uploads aren't removed.

How can I get new images to replace older ones rather than appearing alongside them? I've tried various combinations of removeUI and raw Javascript (removeChild()) but it hasn't worked.


UI

library(shiny)
library(shinyjs)

fluidPage(
    useShinyjs(),

    titlePanel("File upload"),

    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
            fileInput("img", "Choose image", accept=c("image/jpeg", "image/png"))
        ),
        mainPanel(
            HTML('<output id="list"></output>'),
            tags$hr(),
            h3(textOutput("text"))
        )
    )
)

Server

function(input, output, session)
{
    shinyjs::runjs(paste(readLines("showImg.js"), collapse="\n"))

    output$Text <- renderText({
        # long computation goes here
        Sys.sleep(2)
        as.character(input$img$datapath)
    })
}

showImg.js

function handleFileSelect(evt) {
    var files = evt.target.files; // FileList object
    // Loop through the FileList and render image files as thumbnails.
    for (var i = 0, f; f = files[i]; i++) {

        // Only process image files.
        if (!f.type.match('image.*')) {
            continue;
        }

        var reader = new FileReader();

        // Closure to capture the file information.
        reader.onload = (function(theFile) {
            return function (e) {
                var span = document.createElement('span');
                span.innerHTML = ['<img class=\"thumb\" src=\"', e.target.result,
                    '\" height="200px"/>'].join('');
                document.getElementById('list').insertBefore(span, null);
            };
        })(f);

        // Read in the image file as a data URL.
        reader.readAsDataURL(f);
    }
}
document.getElementById('img').addEventListener('change', handleFileSelect, false);
